seed_memories.content: The search::classify module implements a rule-based query classifier that routes each query to one of six types (Episodic, Temporal, Preference, ExactKeyword, Semantic, Exploratory) and produces a QueryStrategy with cc_alpha and limit_multiplier overrides.
Memory of the trip to the orchard: picked two pecks of honeycrisp, drank fresh cider on the hayride, kids fell asleep in the car on the way home.
Note on framing the bathroom mirror: 1x4 poplar, mitered corners, dark walnut stain, hung with sawtooth hangers for level adjustment.
